title: Canonical compact-support scalar total-limit maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with $A=\mathcal O_E$, $B=\mathcal O_F$, uniformizers $t,v$, and an integer $e\geq1$ with $tB=v^eB$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use the derived categories of strict constant integral module towers, the exact finite-free scalar functor $T=-\otimes_A B$, its single-object version $T_0$, and the arithmetic subsequence $K^{(e)}$ retaining positive indices $en$ [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates]. Define $L_A=R\varprojlim$ on the ordinary strict tower category, and likewise $L_B$. Derive the ordinary cone restriction to obtain $r_e:L_B\to L_B\circ(-)^{(e)}$, and use its specified inverse from cofinality [lem-pur-compact-support-roos-cofinality]. Define $\tau:T_0 L_A\xrightarrow{\sim}L_B T$ by the ordinary finite-free tensor/limit comparison transported through the canonical unit-normalized derived-composite comparisons. Let $f:X\to Y$ have a supplied compactification $c$, and let $S_E,S_F$ be coefficient derived-system calculi [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Use their native separately derived proper/open systems $V_H^c$ and their strict restrictions to discrete constants $U_H^c$, for $H=E,F$ [def-pur-native-constant-support-model]. Put $P_H^c=\mathcal L_H V_H^c$, where $\mathcal L_H$ is the actual completed-coefficient total inverse limit [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Define $\operatorname{Res}_H$ by exact derived restriction from completed to discrete constant integral coefficients. Let $\sigma_H:\operatorname{Res}_H P_H^c\xrightarrow{\sim}L_H U_H^c$ be the canonical comparison obtained from the ordinary restriction/limit comparison and the exact whole-system restriction identification. For an object $M$ of the completed integral derived category, write $C_X M$ for its completed scalar extension and use the specified strict scalar mate $q^c:T U_E^c(M)\to(U_F^c(C_XM))^{(e)}$ [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate]. Define the scalar-limit arrow on these actual objects by $a_M^c=r_e^{-1}\circ L_B(q_M^c)\circ\tau$. These definitions supply the maps and their fixed universal normalizations, without asserting the compact-support scalar reduction theorem.
